en.text:
My beam fires for 0.6 seconds, marking 9 spots that detonate in a 7 meter radius after my 0.7 second delay.

Each of my detonations applies <solar/>10 Scorch (15 with the <solar/>Ember of Ashes) to all enemies struck.

<yellow/><bold/>▛ These insights grant us such a feast, O Researcher Mine. You stand [rich] with Desire to [grow] your knowledge. Do you not Wish to [understand] me more...? ▟

//<bold/> You are afflicted by tedious repetition.
